mass. choir practice thursdays at 7.30pm. just come up to gallery to join. all saints' day[a] honours of all the saints of the church.[7][8][9][10] in the 9th century, the catholic church set the date of november 1st for the commemoration of all saints .[11]all saints' day is a solemnity in catholicism in the western christian practice, the liturgical celebration begins with its first vespers on the evening of october 31, all hallows' eve(all saints' eve or hallowe'en), and ends at the compline of november 1. it is thus the day before all souls' day , which commemorates the faithful departed. in many traditions, all saints' day is part of the season of allhallowtide , which includes the three days from october 31 to november 3 inclusive, in places where all saints' day is observed as a public holiday, cemetery and grave rituals such as offerings of flowers, candles and prayers or blessings for the graves of loved ones often take place on all saints' day (along with other days of allsaintstide, especially on all hallows eve and all souls day).[18][19][20][21][22] the ceremonial use of candles symbolize the light of christ and the use of lamps at the tombs of martyrs dates back
